label.description: Visible label. The thumbs are named from it unless thumbLabels is set.

data.description: Raw values the histogram counts, such as every listing's price.

value.description: Controlled range. Leave it out for uncontrolled use.

onValueChange.description: Called on every change while dragging or pressing keys.

onValueCommit.description: Called once a drag is released or a key changes the range.

min.description: Lower bound. Defaults to the smallest data value (or 0).

max.description: Upper bound. Defaults to the largest data value.

bins.description: How many bars the histogram draws.

snapToBins.description: A released thumb near a bar edge settles on it, so the range never cuts a bar in half.

minStepsBetweenThumbs.description: Closest the two thumbs may sit, in steps.

thumbLabels.description: Accessible names for the two thumbs. Defaults to "<label>, minimum" and "<label>, maximum".

name.description: Submits the range with a form, one hidden input per thumb.

disabled.description: Blocks input and removes the thumbs from the tab order.
